title: FAQ: How long does setup take?
caption:
"How long does setup take?" Honest answer: it depends on how many locations and products you have, and whether we connect to an existing system.

Setup includes importing your products, locations and opening stock from your current files, so your team starts with real numbers. We agree on a clear plan in the meeting, before you start.

Book a meeting with our team. Link in bio.
